items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I played drums in there with him for about three weeks. ... a Trombone player called George Washington, was in the band then.

ctx.x: Not so long. It was the last part of the entertainers. We had a nightclub, yeah, you called entertainers. Oh yeah. It was on Franklin Street, they called it, I guess then. Was it a crows out now?

Right. Right. Well, I played drums in there with him for about three weeks. Who else was in the band looking at? Well, at that time I remember Buddy Pity, a Trombone player called George Washington, was in the band then. He had a piano player in the band,
Walter DeCoult. Well, I knew him. He was a piano at that time.
